title: Unique Crisp Brazilian Masarepa Pilaf
description: A pungent and crisp Brazilian dish made with white masarepa, featuring a dehydrated twist, and is egg-free friendly, cooked to perfection in a cataplana vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large cataplana vessel, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the pre-cooked and dried white masarepa, stirring to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Add the dried tomatoes, coconut milk, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Transfer the cataplana vessel to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until the top is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the vessel from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
